summary: PR #261 (CASSSIDECAR-347) caches the merged allowed+excluded map in FilteringMetricRegistry.getMetrics() behind a volatile field. It invalidates the cache from register(), remove() and the excluded-metric creation path. It also precomputes PeriodicTaskExecutor.PeriodicTaskKey.hashCode and adds a CHANGES.txt entry. Applied bundle checklists: absence.md, completeness.md, api-contracts-and-completeness.md, sidecar CONTRIBUTING.md and OPENAPI.md, plus the cass-completeness-symmetry lens notes in sidecar-standards.md. Checked that every mutating path reaches the invalidation. Dropwizard's counter/histogram/meter/timer/gauge go through the overridden register() for allowed metrics, so they are covered. removeMatching goes through the overridden remove(). The excluded-metric path invalidates too early (see cs-1). Not reviewed: nothing; tests were only skimmed.

findings.title: Invalidate allMetrics after the excluded metric is inserted, not before
findings.rule: Counterpart / ordering: cache invalidation must happen after the mutation it guards
findings.problem: addExcludedMetricIfNotExists sets allMetrics = null inside the computeIfAbsent mapping function, before the new entry is stored in excludedMetrics. If getMetrics() runs on another thread in that window, it sees allMetrics == null, rebuilds the snapshot without the new excluded metric and caches it. Nothing invalidates the cache again, so the stale map is returned by getMetrics() until the next unrelated register or remove. The javadoc says this map exists to prevent re-registering excluded metrics. A consumer that reads getMetrics() and then registers a metric that is not in the snapshot can wrongly re-register or duplicate an excluded metric. register() and remove() invalidate after the mutation and are fine. This path is the exception.
findings.fix: Do the invalidation after computeIfAbsent returns, for example: Metric m = excludedMetrics.computeIfAbsent(name, mappingFunction); invalidate(); return m. Alternatively invalidate in a try/finally around it. Extract a shared invalidateAllMetrics() helper for the four call sites.

findings.title: Move the PeriodicTaskKey hashCode caching out of this metrics ticket
findings.rule: Patch does only what the ticket asks
findings.problem: The PeriodicTaskKey hashCode precompute has no relation to CASSSIDECAR-347 (FilteringMetricRegistry#getMetrics). It is not mentioned in the ticket, the PR description or CHANGES.txt, and the diff has no test for it.
findings.fix: Drop it from this patch, or mention it in the PR description and the ticket.
